End of Billa St in area between Dickson Way

I have heard sightings are more regular at Point lookout and very concerned that they were on the immediate roadside with a lot of traffic moving by at speed. Just days later a report of another in a tree by the bustop on main road at cylinder beach. Concerned that there should be more signs, slower driving speed and there is also talk of further development in the area
The trees are also mating trees
I didn't actually see him this time, just heard him outside the bedroom window, they often pass by our house and we hear the large males, have photos from previous occasions
Reported to KAG email.  Caller suspects a M & F
